rows.title: Universal-computation non-result / resolution collapse
rows.statement: For any basis B with finite self-simulation band K_sim(B) and any K ⪰ K_sim∘K_sim, phenotype equivalence ≈_{E,0,K} coincides with table equality, all signature classes with a common table coincide, and M*(E) is independent of E. Hence a Track-B statement carries intelligence-specific content only at K ≺ K_sim(B) or on coordinates (upd, ver, rev) where simulation theorems are silent; above the band the correct terminal is UNIVERSAL_COMPUTATION_ONLY.
assumptions: K_sim(B) finite (invariance thesis for reasonable bases)
rows.parent_theorem: Invariance thesis (van Emde Boas 1990) for finiteness of K_sim; Cybenko/Hornik and Siegelmann–Sontag as the D0 trivializers for neural; Post/clone theory for Boolean (Codex Stage A/C-v0)

rows.title: Basis equivalence / bounded compiler relation
rows.statement: ≡_K and ≈_{E,ε,K} are reflexive and symmetric for every K; they compose with bound K∘K' and tolerance ε+ε'; hence they are equivalence relations exactly when the bound class is closed under composition (K = poly or any ∘-closed class) and tolerances (not necessarily transitive) at a fixed affine constant. Two bases are K-equivalent iff each primitive of one is Φ-equal to a composite of the other with overhead ⪯_K.
assumptions: registered metric on tables satisfies the triangle inequality (trivial at ε=0)
combinator cost algebra additive (else K_C computed per scope)

rows.title: Morphology equivalence quotient and basis-change band
rows.statement: (a) Current-behaviour equivalence does not imply developmental equivalence (exact witness). (b) Morphology classes are 𝓜_k(E,ε,K) = {x : ∃y, Sig_k(y) ∧ x≈y}; syntactically distinct organizations belong to the same class iff mutually K-compilable with equal Q and D tables. (c) Band lemma: if B_1 ≡_K B_2 then class membership and Pareto frontiers transfer between bases up to the band K∘K'∘K; a phase boundary is encoding-robust iff its resource gap exceeds the band on the deciding coordinate.
assumptions: signatures defined on observables preserved by primitive-wise substitution up to constant factors

rows.title: Gradient/backprop update-law derivation
rows.statement: For a bounded differentiable specialization, the gradient update law is specialized from any basis containing + and × on Θ's type: reverse-mode adjoints are themselves arithmetic composites, so the update costs at most a small constant multiple of the forward pass (cheap-gradient principle) — no 'request/backward' primitive is resource-irreducible. In a basis lacking numeric primitives (Boolean/rewrite) the overhead is the arithmetic-emulation constant at precision b (multiplier cost per parameter op). The learning-law-level separation between M4 and local-update classes is therefore NOT derivative availability but update locality (Lemma A, §T10-A): Θ(|Θ|) coordinates written per scalar-loss event.
assumptions: arithmetic circuit model; precision b frozen
scalar loss with generically dense gradient
rows.parent_theorem: Baur & Strassen 1983 / Griewank cheap-gradient principle (constant pending P9A ledger verification); Fong, Spivak & Tuyéras 2019 (backprop as a functor Para→Learn: compositional derivation of the update law); Cruttwell et al. 2022 (reverse-derivative categories); Wilson & Zanasi 2021 (reverse-derivative ascent on Boolean circuits: the same law on a symbolic morphology) — pending P7 ledger
rows.track_b_residual: Measured κ_upd of the gradient law in each candidate basis (Stage D item 1, update step) and the locality bound as the phase-relevant quantity; parent-subtract Backprop-as-Functor explicitly: the compositional derivation is theirs, the charged constants and the cross-basis asymmetry are ours
rows.proof_artifact: proofs/GMI_PROOFS_V1.md §T10-A Lemma A (locality); cheap-gradient corollary is parent
rows.exact_checker: Stage D P1a HOLDS: gradient law into the rewrite basis costs 107-116x the compositional-learner basis on upd at 8-bit precision (frozen threshold 8x). P9A ledger adds a theorem-grade non-invariance at the update coordinate: gradient complexity Θ(1) (DAG+adjoint, Baur-Strassen; ≤4x Griewank-Walther), Θ(d) (black-box), n^{1+Ω(1)} (formulas/planar circuits, Ramya-Shastri 2025 Cor. 45-46). P7 ledger: Gavranović 2022 shows denotational equivalence erases the memory/recomputation distinction, so a cost functor must be 2-categorical — the exact place where the charged constants live.
rows.counterexample_when_assumption_removed: sparse gradients (e.g. one-hot targets with ReLU dead units) ⇒ locality SPARSE, slope of §T10-A weakens; must be measured not assumed
rows.empirical_bridge: #214 FNA (learned update laws in explicit machinery)
rows.claim_ceiling: Compositional derivation PARENT_SUFFICIENT; locality bound P1; constants P2.
rows.falsifier: A basis in which the gradient step compiles with κ_upd growing faster than the emulation constant would contradict cheap-gradient in that basis — report CANNOT_CHECK or a modelling defect in ρ

rows.title: Probabilistic-program / Bayes specialization
rows.statement: Stochastic generative composites and conditioning are specialized from a basis with sample/score/normalize primitives wherever the conditional distribution is computable (finite discrete observations; computable densities); conditioning on a general computable random variable is NOT computable (Ackerman–Freer–Roy 2011), which bounds the row to finite exact scope (P5 boundary). Bayesian updating composes as a lens/optic (Smithe 2020), i.e. it lives in the same compositional algebra as the gradient law.

rows.title: Ecology relativity / no universal morphology
rows.statement: (a) NFL: no morphology is Pareto-optimal across all ecologies under closure-under-permutation-type conditions on the task class. (b) Stronger, theorem-grade flips already exist along registered axes: the same target class (DFA) is intractable to learn passively (Gold 1978; Pitt–Warmuth 1993; Kearns–Valiant 1994) and polynomial with membership+equivalence queries (Angluin 1987); parity is not SQ/gradient-learnable (Kearns 1998; Abbe et al. 2021) but is exactly searchable; more samples can buy less computation (comp–stat tradeoff). Hence morphology claims require ecology restrictions along at least the axes verification_strength, feedback_type, data_volume×compute, noise, distribution structure.
assumptions: parent theorems' own assumptions (verification pending P9B ledger)
rows.quantifiers: ∃ ecology pairs with proven flips; ∀ morphology no universal dominance
rows.parent_theorem: Wolpert & Macready 1997; Wolpert 1996; Schumacher–Vose–Whitley 2001; Gold 1978; Pitt & Warmuth 1993; Kearns & Valiant 1994; Angluin 1987; Kearns 1998; Shalev-Shwartz et al. 2017; Abbe et al. 2021; Shalev-Shwartz–Shamir–Tromer 2012; Valiant 2009 — all pending P9B ledger verification
rows.track_b_residual: The parents prove per-class learnability separations; none defines morphology classes by bounded compilation, charges both sides from a common basis, or predicts Pareto-optimal CLASS under multi-axis ecologies. Track B's residual is the class-level, resource-charged reading of these flips (GMI-T10).

rows.empirical_bridge: #221 must never claim a universal winner; #373 §11 generality = invariant laws not one solver
rows.claim_ceiling: Parent-anchored P5/P3; Track B adds no theorem here, only the axis registry.

rows.title: Morphology recovery identifiability
rows.statement: (Impossibility) If Φ_E(x_1) = Φ_E(x_2) on every registered probe ecology, no classifier distinguishes them; signature classes are not identifiable from behaviour alone when two signatures admit table-equal members with equal resource profiles. (Positive target) update_locality is identifiable from R_upd growth along a size ladder; feedback_dependence from which channels change D; theta_type and store_discipline require desc-growth and drift probes. rows.title: Developmental morphogenesis
rows.statement: Whether experience transforms the distribution over future USEFUL MORPHOLOGIES (class-level Ev, HST-T10 lifted to 𝓜_k), not only current-task performance; and its limits: some representable structures are not acquirable by bounded evolution/SQ-type processes (Valiant 2009: parity not evolvable), and a finite trajectory never proves unbounded future novelty (HST-T13). Kirsch et al. (emergent learning algorithms in meta-learned substrates, with a reported memorization→generalization transition in task diversity) is the closest existing D2 evidence at the learning-law level, within one substrate and one outer loop.
formal_objects: Ev_t lifted to classes: P_{x'~Q_t}[x' ∈ 𝓜_k ∧ Useful]
rows.quantifiers: ∀ generations g on a registered ecology shift
rows.parent_theorem: Valiant 2009 evolvability (limit); Feldman 2008; HST-T10/T12/T13; Kirsch & Schmidhuber 2021, Kirsch et al. 2022 (empirical D2 at learning-law level); PowerPlay/OOPS (solver growth ≠ morphology change) — pending ledgers

extension_rows_codex_v3.statement: Every frozen finite deterministic network of finite-state local units with finite topology/configuration state is exactly representable as one deterministic finite-state transducer whose global state is the Cartesian product of local and topology states.
extension_rows_codex_v3.consequence: Local adaptive-unit decomposition is not a new finite expressivity class; residuals must be resource/factorization/developmental.

extension_rows_codex_v3.statement: At the registered two-node binary structured grammar, state adaptation and topology adaptation produce different developmental phenotype sets; allowing both yields additional interaction-only phenotypes.
extension_rows_codex_v3.claim_boundary: Fixed grammar/resource bound only; finite-state parent sufficient for expressivity.

extension_rows_codex_v3.statement: In the registered one-example binary-label ecology, local-state storage and topology/edge storage are both perfect but Pareto-distinct; under the registered scalarization topology wins iff w_state > 2*w_desc + w_edge + H*w_message.
extension_rows_codex_v3.claim_boundary: Calibrates frontier/phase machinery; no GMI novelty.

extension_rows_codex_v3.statement: A tiny finite cross-paradigm representability demonstration cannot establish a common intelligence substrate because finite target behavior/update can be flattened into a finite table/transducer.
extension_rows_codex_v3.consequence: Stage D must test families/scaling and bounded developmental compilation.

extension_rows_codex_v3.statement: Morphogenesis questions should separate basis closure M_B, developmental feasible/frontier set F_B(E), and search dynamics Gamma; a wrong frontier prediction is distinct from a search failure.

Expressive universality, finite local adaptive structure, and description minimality do not currently identify a representation-independent unique cognitive atom; the live target is a resource-bounded equivalence class of execution/development bases.
extension_rows_codex_v3.boundary: Does not prove that no stronger physically/resource-defined unique basis can exist.

extension_rows_codex_v3.statement: A shared basis preserves the native scaling/update structure of at least neural, symbolic, probabilistic and programmatic morphology families under a frozen bounded-compilation class without architecture-labelled macros.

For at least one disjoint ecology coordinate change, the complete/faithfully estimated developmental morphology frontier changes in a quantitatively predicted way before protected search, and neutral search subsequently recovers the predicted frontier classes.
extension_rows_codex_v3.required_residual: endogenous morphology generation + developmental cost + pre-search frontier prediction + blind recovery

extension_rows_codex_v4.statement: Any frozen finite deterministic network of finite local adaptive units and finite topology/configuration states flattens exactly to one finite-state transducer over the global product state.
extension_rows_codex_v4.consequence: Local adaptive units/topology do not establish a new computational class at finite scope.

extension_rows_codex_v4.statement: A common universal execution basis plus separately hand-authored target-specific compilers is insufficient evidence for a fundamental machine-intelligence substrate because the compiler can encode the architecture-specific prior.
extension_rows_codex_v4.consequence: Charge compiler description/build/search cost; prefer one frozen uniform compiler or developmental acquisition.

extension_rows_codex_v4.statement: For n independent binary state cells with n-bit input and local XOR update, a flat explicit transition table has 4^n state-input entries while factored and ordinary-program execution use O(n) XOR operations.
extension_rows_codex_v4.consequence: Factorization matters; flat-state equivalence does not select a privileged cognitive basis because a general program also preserves compact structure.

extension_rows_codex_v4.statement: At registered model assumptions, a sufficiently expressive typed program/computation-graph representation compactly realizes neural/differentiable, production/symbolic, probabilistic/factorized, and programmatic families; family-specific compilers/algorithms remain prior information.
extension_rows_codex_v4.consequence: Cross-paradigm execution representation is too weak for GMI novelty.

extension_rows_codex_v4.statement: A finite fully specified costed developmental configuration process is a stochastic-shortest-path / metalevel MDP instance under standard assumptions.
extension_rows_codex_v4.consequence: Novelty must come from compact structural prediction/generalization, not merely defining a costed state graph.

extension_rows_codex_v4.statement: For ecology P and morphology proposal prior Q, expected ideal code/search burden is H(P)+D_KL(P||Q). With build cost B and horizon N, expected lifetime burden is B+N[H(P)+D_KL(P||Q)].
extension_rows_codex_v4.consequence: One morphology can dominate because its inductive/proposal bias matches ecology sufficiently well to repay build cost; this is not GMI novelty.

extension_rows_codex_v4.statement: For the registered structured-vs-uniform proposal distributions, the exact ecology/horizon phase boundary is p*(H,B)=[ln(2.5)+B/H]/ln4.
A prefix-tree/code morphology mechanically induces proposal probabilities via Kraft weights; the registered tree structures yield exact expected-burden and horizon-dependent phase boundaries.
extension_rows_codex_v4.consequence: Validates structure->geometry methodology where the mapping is known analytically.

extension_rows_codex_v4.statement: Under a pre-frozen source-coding protocol, label-free exhaustive search over all 13 valid registered code structures recovered all five prospectively predicted morphology regions at p={0.10,0.25,0.50,0.75,0.90}.
extension_rows_codex_v4.consequence: The prediction->neutral search->post-hoc classification pipeline works in a mature parent domain; no GMI credit.

extension_rows_codex_v4.statement: In #323's registered OCM-like morphology, developmental history moved the eventual verified solution earlier in proposal order on 2536/2741 fresh targets (92.5%), median 1.91 bits search saved, while target solutions were absent from history.
extension_rows_codex_v4.claim_boundary: Single registered grammar/morphology family; does not establish cross-paradigm structure->geometry law or K2.

extension_rows_codex_v4.statement: Fixed-portfolio ecology-feature->algorithm choice is classical algorithm selection; experience-conditioned future priors/learning algorithms are meta-learning; cost-aware computation choice is rational metareasoning.
extension_rows_codex_v4.consequence: Track B must generate morphology endogenously and predict geometry from structure, not merely select from a supplied portfolio.

extension_rows_codex_v4.statement: Pre-target compact structural signatures can predict a morphology's proposal/update/resource geometry and first-verified-solution burden on held-out tasks/ecologies better than strongest algorithm-selection/performance-prediction parents.
The same invariant family predicts developmental burden/frontier transitions across materially different morphology paradigms and held-out ecologies.
A theory-predicted phase-diagram hole can be filled by neutral search discovering a morphology not developmentally/resource-equivalent to every applicable registered known parent.

Universal/program representation + domain-specific compilers + AutoML/NAS/program evolution + meta-learning + algorithm selection + rational metareasoning + information theory may fully explain the complete Track-B signature.
